examples.explanation: Buy at 2, sell at 4 for profit 2; no second profitable trade exists.
Trade 2->6 (profit 4) and 0->3 (profit 3) for a total of 7.
With one trade allowed, buy at 1 and sell at 5.

hints: When k is at least half the number of days, every upward step can be taken: sum all positive day-to-day differences.
Otherwise track, for each trade count j, the best balance while holding (buy[j]) and while free (sell[j]), updating both as each price arrives.
A buy on day i uses sell[j-1] - price; a sell uses buy[j] + price. The answer is sell[k].
title: 328. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV
